H01.description: When build.chunkImportMap is enabled the head code non-null-asserts getImportMap's result, so a bundle with no import map asset gives undefined and the importMap.mapping access crashes instead of the block being skipped.

I01.description: Sourcemap snapshot updated after a later rolldown dependency bump; not a defect in the head code.

I02.description: With chunk import maps, the head code leaves preload dependencies and import-map key selection out of chunk hashing, so a chunk's hash can stay the same while its preload keys change, which leaves stale cached chunks.
